name: run_dynamic_stress

test_list.description: Each case is sent as stdin to the configured argv through SandboxBackend::exec.
Every execution receives the configured timeout and bounded output limit.
Sandbox errors propagate with destroy attempted after successful creation.
A backend result exceeding the requested cap becomes an error and cleanup still runs.
An owned cleanup task observes caller cancellation and tears down a created sandbox.
Cancellation waits for create to resolve before destroying a newly created sandbox.
Caller-side timeout bounds a backend exec future that ignores the SDK timeout field.
A process exit alone cannot claim a sanitizer diagnosis or reproducible defect.
Each run retains its submitted bounded stdin, seed and argv as replay evidence.
SDK output is capped and secret/PII redacted before it is returned.
Reports derive zero model tokens from an inaccessible private meter.

inputs.name: plan
inputs.description: Caller-configured sandbox spec, executable argv, wall timeout, output cap and bounded cases.

inputs.name: backend
inputs.description: Actual SDK SandboxBackend selected by the composition root.

output_description: Bounded observed command outcomes with seed and exact argv. This does not claim the backend's configured sandbox provides host isolation.
